scenes.text: The house had five rooms. Everyone agreed on that.
Five rooms, one hall, one front door.
But every night, someone walked past the bedroom twice.
The floorboards counted six sets of footsteps.
The house had five rooms. It always had six visitors.
Follow for more Quiet Horror Files.
